mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 8.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equity markets and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95 but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment level (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rises but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 2.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST both decline but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase (defined by GDPC1 > 13000 and INDPRO > 95), a rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where GDPC1 > 13000 and INDPRO > 95, RSAFS rises but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of cases.
